title: Splitting the radial first-variation integrand, with the signs of its parts
statement: Let n and l be natural numbers, mu a measure on R^(n+l), w : R^(n+l) -> R, y in R^(n+l), R and eps real, and phi : R -> R. Assume eps > 0; mu(closedBall y R) < infinity; w is a.e.-strongly measurable for mu restricted to the open ball ball y R, and 0 <= w(x) <= 1 for mu-a.e. x in ball y R; phi is C^1 and nonincreasing, with phi(u) = 1 for u <= 1 and phi(u) = 0 for u >= 1 + eps. Let t be real with t > 0 and (1 + eps) t < R. Write r_x := |x - y| and phi' := deriv phi; all integrals are Bochner integrals over R^(n+l) with respect to mu. Then: (a) integral (n phi(r_x/t) + (r_x/t) phi'(r_x/t)(1 - w(x))) dmu = n integral phi(r_x/t) dmu + integral (r_x/t) phi'(r_x/t) dmu - integral (r_x/t) phi'(r_x/t) w(x) dmu; (b) integral phi(r_x/t) dmu >= 0; (c) integral (r_x/t) phi'(r_x/t) w(x) dmu <= 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (w : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (R ε : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → μ (closedBall y R) < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable w (μ.restrict (ball y R)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ball y R → 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ u → φ u = 0) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → (1 + ε) * t < R → ∫ x, ((n : ℝ) * φ (‖x - y‖ / t) + ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * (1 - w x)) ∂μ = (n : ℝ) * ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ + ∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ - ∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * w x ∂μ ∧ 0 ≤ ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ ∧ ∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * w x ∂μ ≤ 0
